results.name: Bugatti Destrier
results.description:
Named after the strongest battle horses of medieval knights, this is the third car to come out of Bugattis "Solitaire" programme, after the Broulliard and the F.K.P Hommage. A one of one commissioned  hyper car built based on the track only Bolide, with the same carbon fiber monocoque, but no aero, it features the iconic W16 making up to 1578 bhp, and its only 1 meter tall- the lowest any Bugatti have ever been. I may be the first personake a model of this car and put it online. I literally began modelling an hour after Bugatti posted their official video for this car.
![https://www.topgear.com/sites/default/files/2026/08/5.BUGATTI_New%20Solitaire_Aug%206%2C%202026_EXT_Front34.jpg?w=1920&h=1080](http://)
Most reference materials I used are available on the Bugatti newsletter website.

results.name: Monumento de la Camioneta del Viento
results.description:
historia viene de los fortísimos vientos patagónicos de la zona. La escultura representa cómo el viento de Comodoro “destruye” o castiga a los vehículos y a todo lo que encuentra. Por eso la camioneta aparece totalmente doblada, aplastada y deformada.

El monumento estuvo muchos años cerca de la costa y se volvió una especie de símbolo local y meme antes de que existieran los memes modernos. Mucha gente que viajaba por la ruta o iba a la costanera se sacaba fotos ahí.

No representa un accidente real específico; es más bien una obra artística/humorística sobre:

el viento extremo de la Patagonia,
la dureza del clima,
y la identidad comodorense.

En Comodoro hay ráfagas que a veces superan los 100 km/h, así que el chiste era:

“Así te deja el viento”.

results.description: The M10 Booker is a U.S. Army tracked combat vehicle designed to provide infantry brigade combat teams with mobile, direct-fire support. results.name: ADATS
results.description: The ADATS (Air Defense Anti-Tank System) is a dual-purpose, short-range, surface-to-air, and anti-tank missile system. Developed by Oerlikon Contraves (Switzerland) and Martin Marietta (USA), it fires a laser-guided supersonic missile capable of tracking and destroying low-flying aircraft, helicopters, and heavily armored ground targets.

results.name: SCP-4059: The Jersey Devil
results.description:
While the nature and origins of the creature are unknown, The most common version of the story says that a woman by the name of Mrs. Leeds, exhausted from having 12 children, in labor, cursed her 13th child, preferring a monster than another mouth to feed. when the child was born, it initially appeared normal, but then quickly transformed into a winged monster with goat, horse, and demon features. The creature let out a bloodcurdling scream, flew out of the house, and disappeared into the Pine Barrens.  The Jersey Devil's current actions include terrorizing people, killing livestock, destroying property, and causing crops to fail. It is also described as screaming chillingly, and leaving behind strange tracks. However, the SCP foundation classifies it as a collective series of anomalies centered around the Pinelands National Reserve in New Jersey. The designation refers to a specific ritual and related events involving a creature and an individual known as Subject A.

results.name: iOS Fast and Furious 4 - Land Train Scene
results.description: ![https://share.google/images/yL4mmjke01KS3enml](http://https://share.google/images/yL4mmjke01KS3enml)This is the 1st pursuit mission in the game where you drive a star car such as the pickup truck "Riot" or the muscle car "Gothico" and take down 3 trailers of oil before you destroy the truck. On the iOS version, you must hit it 3-4 times in order to take one tanker down, while in the java version, you rub against it until the health bar fills up. The mission is pretty simple, but you must make sure you are taking down the last oil trailer, otherwise no damage will be done the the oil trailers, and you might even spin out in mid air trying to do so. I might release more models of the missions like these in the future. Lastly, it would be greatly appreciated if you go check out the trailer I made for the game https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TMRZyq1cyRU
